_comment: Tier-2 Layer-C: kratos linear_elasticity numerical-correctness gate. Cross-backend mirror of fenics + skfem + ngsolve elasticity_mms_convergence. The Kratos catalog template (src/backends/kratos/generators/linear_elasticity.py) uses a scipy-Voigt-B-matrix manual assembly pattern with plane-strain D-matrix [[λ+2μ, λ, 0], [λ, λ+2μ, 0], [0, 0, μ]] — engineering γ_xy notation. Task #25 tracks migration to KratosMultiphysics StructuralMechanicsApplication; floors here will still hold. Same MMS u = (sin(πx)·sin(πy), sin(2πx)·sin(2πy)), plane strain E=1.0/ν=0.3, f = -μ·Δu - (λ+μ)·grad(div(u)) (Navier form). Asserts P1 nx=32 L2 error <= 1.3e-2 and P1 EOC nx=16 → nx=32 in [1.7, 2.3]. Verified on 2026-06-01: P1=6.90e-3, EOC=1.928. CROSS-BACKEND AGREEMENT: kratos 6.90e-3 vs fenics 8.99e-3 vs skfem 8.96e-3 vs ngsolve 1.31e-2 — kratos is lowest because the centroid-quadrature for f aligns well with sin·sin manufactured source (similar advantage seen in kratos poisson gate, commit 61019ee). MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 injects the defect this numeric gate exists to catch: the body force is sampled at the triangle FIRST VERTEX instead of its centroid, an O(h) consistency error in the load. Measured: P1 h=1/32 L2 error goes to 4.717e-02 (over the 1.3e-2 floor) and the observed EOC goes 2.0 -> 1.042. NOTE ON WHAT THIS FIXTURE ASSERTS: its expect_in_output entries "P1_h32_l2err=" and "P1_eoc_h16_to_h32=" are bare PREFIXES matching any value, so the numeric gate rests ENTIRELY on the forbid string "FAIL:". Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: no expect string disappears -- the fixture goes red on the forbidden FAIL: lines for both the error floor and the EOC window. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/elasticity_mms_convergence && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
